ValidationRule.description: Users cannot change 'Engagement Status' to "No Contact", once out of that value
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Engagement_Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Engagement_Status__c, "No Contact"), OR( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Engagement_Status__c)) = "Program Issues", TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Engagement_Status__c)) = "No Need Yet - Cold", TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Engagement_Status__c)) = "No Need Yet - Warm", TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Engagement_Status__c)) = "Interested" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot change the Engagement Status back to "No Contact"
